chapters.title: Foundations of Digital Forensics 🔍
chapters.description: Step into the world of cyber investigations. Learn what digital forensics is, its core principles, and why every byte matters.

chapters.title: The Forensic Investigation Process 🧭
chapters.description: Master the step-by-step methodology used by professionals: from identification to reporting.

chapters.title: Computer Forensics Fundamentals 💻
chapters.description: Dive into file systems, data representation, and the building blocks of digital evidence on computers.

chapters.title: Data Acquisition & Imaging 📸
chapters.description: Learn to safely create forensic images using write-blockers and verify integrity with hashing.

chapters.title: File System Analysis 🗃️
chapters.description: Decode FAT, NTFS, and other file systems. Recover deleted files and carve data from unallocated space.

chapters.title: Windows Forensics 🪟
chapters.description: Extract crucial artifacts from the Windows Registry, event logs, jump lists, and more.

chapters.title: Memory Forensics 🧠
chapters.description: Capture RAM dumps and analyze volatile data to uncover hidden processes, malware, and encryption keys.

chapters.title: Network Forensics 🌐
chapters.description: Sniff packets, dissect protocols, and trace intrusions through network traffic analysis.

chapters.title: Mobile Forensics 📱
chapters.description: Explore iOS and Android artifacts, acquisition challenges, and device-specific data recovery.

chapters.title: Email & Browser Forensics 📧
chapters.description: Trace email origins, analyze headers, and dig through browser history and cache for clues.

chapters.title: Anti-Forensics & Countermeasures 🛡️
chapters.description: Understand encryption, steganography, and wiping techniques – and how to defeat them.

chapters.title: Reporting & Expert Witness 📄
chapters.description: Craft bulletproof forensic reports and learn how to testify confidently in court.

chapters.title: Advanced Topics & The Future 🚀
chapters.description: Explore cloud forensics, IoT investigations, and emerging trends that shape tomorrow's cases.
